title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-6lxk: literal_regular_fragment test has stale expected value 0x7c, should be 0x3e
description: Test literal_regular_fragment in rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:1297 expects header byte [0x78, 0x7c] for fragment with rule_id=0x78, window=0, fcn=62. With FRAGMENT_N=6, the encoding is: ((window & 1) << 6) | (fcn & 0x3F) = (0 << 6) | 62 = 0x3e. The expected value 0x7c is stale — likely from an earlier encoding scheme (FRAGMENT_N=7 would still give 0x3e for fcn=62). Change line 1297: [0x78, 0x7c] -> [0x78, 0x3e]. Pre-existing bug, not introduced by this commit.
